gen-gf-warnes-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca draws one unshaded line with big lowercase and small-looking capitals. Warnes brings stretched, spacious bold display letters with strokes that taper out before touching, and that loud-against-quiet gap is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mada: Approachable and modern, Mada lifts its curves up into a towering midzone while leaving them open at the ends. Warnes, with the same line width in every curve and straight, does its best work big and brief.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads huge in the lowercase, with letters hung like clothespins on a long line. And page after page it would feel crisp and uniform, with Warnes left to shout in bold stretched letters above.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One lets a wide stretch of blank space sit between each letter of its sizable lowercase. But the loudest thing is Warnes, whose bold ink strokes taper out before touching and carry no brush-like swell.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mozilla-headline: Warnes draws every stroke at a constant width, tapering its ink out before the letters touch, with stretched, spacious tracking. Mozilla Headline meets it with big-bodied lowercase and flared c endings.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text looks bold in lowercase because its letter bodies run so large. Warnes is best at making a loud, stretched statement in strokes of constant width, while Mozilla Text is best at carrying words with flared terminals.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-nobile: Nobile reads crisp and contemporary, with open letter mouths like an unjoined chalk arc and capitals sitting barely above the lowercase. Warnes handles the bent-pipe shouting; Nobile does the quiet talking.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Loud meets tidy: Warnes stretches out in bold ink strokes of lockstep stems and arcs. Noto Kufi Arabic settles in beneath with an open gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans: Slim joins, stretched letters, bold attitude up top. Warnes does its best work as a big, spaced-out display statement, while Noto Sans does its best filling lowercase bodies that use most of the letter height.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Warnes goes bold and stretched, with no contrast between stems and joins. Noto Sans Adlam would read smoothly for pages, its curve endings held well apart and its c, s and z full and generous.
